knowledge_base: Anker eufy 售后长尾问题双语知识库
data_source: 黑客松智能服务赛题资料.xlsx

entries.question_en: Only received the replacement parts kit, not the vacuum
entries.question_cn: 只收到配件包，主机没到
entries.response_en: Your order Anker001 was split into 2 packages: Parts kit tracking Anker1234567 (delivered 9/21), Main unit tracking Anker1234567-1 (delivered 9/23). If the main unit still hasn't arrived, I'll launch an internal investigation immediately.
entries.response_cn: 我查到您的订单 Anker001 拆分为 2 个包裹 发出：配件包单号 Anker1234567（已签收 9/21），主机包裹单号 Anker1234567-1（已签收 9/23）。如主机仍未收到，我立即为您启动内部核查。

entries.question_en: Tracking shows label created but no further updates
entries.question_cn: 物流单号显示 label created 后无更新
entries.response_en: Label Created means the carrier has received the shipping info. Physical pickup usually takes 1-2 business days. Your tracking Anker1234567-2 currently shows Delivered on 9/21. If no update after 3 business days, I'll initiate a carrier inquiry.
entries.response_cn: 标签创建（Label Created）表示承运商已收到发货信息，实物揽收通常需要 1-2 个工作日。您的包裹单号 Anker1234567-2 目前状态为 Delivered on 9/21，如超 3 个工作日仍无更新，我为您发起承运商查询。

entries.question_en: Package shows in transit but ETA has passed
entries.question_cn: 物流显示 in transit，预计到达时间已过
synonyms_en: still in transit past delivery date
entries.response_en: Your order Anker005 is currently in transit, estimated arrival 9/30. That date has passed. I'm launching a carrier inquiry with FedEx right now, typically 1-2 business days for feedback.
entries.response_cn: 您的订单 Anker005 当前状态为 in transit，预计到达 9/30。已过预计时间，我立即为您向 FedEx 发起物流查询，通常 1-2 个工作日有反馈。

entries.question_en: Tracking shows Return to sender but no refund received
entries.question_cn: 物流显示 Return to sender，但我没收到退款
synonyms_cn: return to sender 什么意思
entries.response_en: Your order Anker007 shows Return to sender. Possible reasons: incorrect address or multiple failed delivery attempts. Would you prefer re-shipment (please confirm new address) or a full refund? I'll register it immediately.
entries.response_cn: 我查到订单 Anker007 的包裹状态为 Return to sender（退回寄件人），原因可能是地址有误或多次投递无人接收。您希望我们重新寄送（确认新地址）还是直接退款？我立即为您登记。

entries.question_en: Order shows not shipped but pre-order date has passed
entries.question_cn: 订单显示未发货，但已过预售发货日期
entries.response_en: Your order Anker008 is a pre-order product, estimated ship date 2026/10/20. The filters you received are accessories (shipped separately). If you don't want to wait for the main unit, I can cancel and fully refund it.
entries.response_cn: 您的订单 Anker008 为预售产品，预计 2026/10/20 发货。您已收到的滤网是订单中的配件（单独发货）。如您不想继续等待主机，我可以为您取消主机订单并全额退款。

entries.question_en: Order number not found in system
entries.question_cn: 订单号查不到，但客户坚称已下单
entries.response_en: I searched for your order number and could not find it in our system. Please confirm the order number, or provide the purchase channel (Amazon / official website / offline store) + purchase receipt screenshot. Order not found does not mean it was cancelled.
entries.response_cn: 我查询了您提供的订单号，在系统中暂未找到对应记录。请确认订单号是否正确，或提供购买渠道（Amazon / 官网 / 线下店）+ 购买凭证截图，我帮您进一步核实。订单查无不代表被取消。

entries.question_en: One package delivered, one missing from split shipment
entries.question_cn: 同一订单拆成两个包裹，一个签收一个丢失
synonyms_en: only one of two packages arrived
synonyms_cn: 一个包裹到了一个没到
entries.response_en: Your order was split into 2 packages. Package 1 Anker1234567 delivered 9/21; Package 2 Anker1234567-1 delivered 9/23. If Package 2 wasn't received, I'll launch a separate lost package investigation for Package 2.
entries.response_cn: 您的订单拆分为 2 个包裹。包裹1 Anker1234567 已签收 9/21；包裹2 Anker1234567-1 已签收 9/23。如包裹2 实际未收到，我为您单独发起包裹2 的丢失调查。

entries.question_en: Tracking shows Delivered but customer did not receive
entries.question_cn: 物流状态显示 Delivered，但客户未收到
synonyms_cn: 显示已签收但我没收到
entries.response_en: Your package Anker1234567-11 shows delivered on 9/25, but you haven't received it. I'm launching a carrier lost package investigation with USPS, typically 3-5 business days. Please also confirm if the shipping address is correct.
entries.response_cn: 系统显示您的包裹 Anker1234567-11 已于 9/25 签收，但您未收到。我立即为您发起承运商（USPS）丢失调查，通常 3-5 个工作日有结果。同时请确认收货地址是否为正确地址。

entries.response_en: Carriers are automatically assigned by the warehouse based on your address; specific carriers cannot be requested. I'll note your preference, and the warehouse will try to accommodate. If you've had a bad experience, I'll pass it to our logistics team.
entries.response_cn: 目前承运商由仓库根据您的地址自动匹配，暂不支持指定。但我会为您备注偏好，仓库会尽量参考。如对当前承运商有不良体验，我帮您向物流团队反馈。

entries.question_en: Customer asks to change shipping address
entries.question_cn: 客户询问订单地址是否可修改
entries.response_en: Your order status is {status}. If not shipped, address can be changed — please provide the new address. If shipped, already handed to {carrier}; I'll try to intercept and reroute, but cannot guarantee success.
entries.response_cn: 您的订单当前状态为 {status}。未发货可以修改地址，请提供新地址。已发货包裹已交给 {carrier}，我会尝试联系承运商拦截改派，但不保证成功。

entries.question_en: Clean water tank full but says empty
entries.question_cn: 清水箱已加满但 App 仍提示不足
entries.response_en: For 6011: 1. Check seal ring on water outlet for deformation/damage; 2. Check magnet at bottom of tank; 3. Reinstall and ensure click sound. If error persists, likely base station hardware issue — I'll arrange replacement.
entries.response_cn: 关于 6011 错误：1. 取出清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否变形/破损；2. 检查清水箱底部磁铁是否在位；3. 重新安装并确保听到卡扣声。如仍报错，可能是基站硬件问题，我为您安排换新。

entries.response_en: For 6018: Latest firmware has optimized water injection strategy. Please update firmware in the app and retry. If still failing and under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 关于 6018 错误：新版固件已优化注水策略。请在 App 中升级至最新固件后重新执行拖地任务。如仍失败，且在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 2010 is a hardware failure — the machine cannot self-recover. Rest assured, if under warranty, we'll immediately arrange a warranty replacement.
entries.response_cn: 经核查，2010 错误属于硬件故障，机器无法自行恢复。请放心，如在保，我们立即为您安排保修换新。

entries.question_cn: 机器人与基站通信错误
entries.response_en: 5112 indicates communication anomaly between robot and base station — a hardware issue. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 5112 错误表示机器人与基站通信异常，属于硬件问题。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 4090 is a wall sensor hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll arrange a replacement.
entries.response_cn: 4090 错误为墙体传感器异常，属于硬件问题。如在保，我们为您安排换新。

entries.question_en: Base station clean water pump/sprinkler error
entries.question_cn: 基站清水泵/洒水器错误
entries.response_en: 6012/6013 is a base station clean water pump/sprinkler hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty replacement.
entries.response_cn: 6012/6013 为基站清水泵/洒水器硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修换新。

entries.response_en: 7053: Move the robot to a flat surface before starting. If error persists on flat ground, please enable log upload in the app — our engineers will analyze.
entries.response_cn: 7053 错误：请先将机器移至平整地面启动。如平整地面仍报错，请在 App 中开启日志上传，我们的工程师会帮您分析。

entries.response_en: 4040 is a camera hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 4040 错误为摄像头无数据，属于硬件问题。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 7003: Move the robot to a flat surface. If error persists, enable log upload in the app — our engineers will help.
entries.response_cn: 7003 错误：请将机器移至平整地面。如平整地面仍报错，请在 App 中开启日志上传，工程师帮您分析。

entries.question_cn: 地毯检测传感器/超声波传感器错误
entries.response_en: 4120/4121 is a carpet detection/ultrasonic sensor hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll arrange a replacement.
entries.response_cn: 4120/4121 为地毯检测传感器/超声波传感器硬件故障。如在保，我们为您安排换新。

entries.response_en: 4020 is a gyroscope hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 4020 为陀螺仪硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 3030/3031 is a robot dirty water pump hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 3030/3031 为机器人污水泵硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 3010/3011 is a robot clean water pump hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 3010/3011 为机器人清水泵硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 2235 is an extendable side brush hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 2235 为可伸缩边刷硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 4010 is a laser sensor hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 4010 为激光传感器硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 3210 is a roller mop motor hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 3210 为滚筒拖布电机硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 2113 is a roller brush module hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 2113 为滚刷模块硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 2220/2221/2224/2225 is a side brush hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 2220/2221/2224/2225 为边刷硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 5017 is a battery pack hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 5017 为电池组硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.response_en: 2234: Check if extendable side brush is tangled with strings/cables/plastic bags/hair. Clean and ensure free movement. If error persists, we'll arrange a replacement.
entries.response_cn: 2234 错误：请检查可伸缩边刷是否被绳索/数据线/塑料袋/头发缠绕，清理后确保边刷可自由移动。如仍报错，我们为您安排换新。

entries.response_en: 1013/1023: Check side wheels for tangled cables/hair. Clean and ensure wheels rotate freely. If robot frequently gets stuck in specific areas, set a no-go zone in the app.
entries.response_cn: 1013/1023 错误：请检查侧轮是否被线缆/头发缠绕，清理后确保轮子正常转动。如机器常在特定位置卡住，建议在 App 中设置禁区。

entries.response_en: 4091: Gently wipe the right wall sensor with a soft cloth, then place on flat ground and restart.
entries.response_cn: 4091 错误：请用软布轻轻擦拭机器人右侧墙体传感器表面，然后置于平整地面重启。

entries.response_en: 6080/6081 is a sewage extraction fan hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 6080/6081 为污水抽取风扇硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.question_en: Return robot to base station for self-cleaning
entries.question_cn: 多楼层任务中提示放回基站清洗拖布
entries.response_en: In multi-floor tasks, the robot cannot wash the mop on floors without a base station and will automatically downgrade to vacuum-only mode. To mop, please return the robot to the base station to wash the mop first. Use Multi-Map Saving feature.
entries.response_cn: 多楼层任务中，机器无法在无基站的楼层清洗拖布，会自动降级为纯扫地模式。如需拖地，请先将机器放回基站清洗拖布。可使用 Multi-Map Saving 功能。

entries.response_en: 7040: The robot encountered an obstacle while leaving the base station. Check and remove obstacles around the base station.
entries.response_cn: 7040 错误：机器人离开基站时遇到障碍。请检查基站周围并移除障碍物。

entries.response_en: 1012/1022 is a left/right wheel motor hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 1012/1022 为左/右轮电机硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.question_en: Station wastewater or dust collection device error
entries.question_cn: 基站废水或集尘装置错误
synonyms_cn: station wastewater or dust collection device error
entries.response_en: 6061/6062 is a base station wastewater/dust collection device hardware failure. If under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 6061/6062 为基站废水或集尘装置硬件故障。如在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.question_en: Dust bin or filter not in place
entries.question_cn: 尘盒或滤网未安装到位
entries.response_en: 2310: 1. Remove dust bin, open lid, check if filter is installed; 2. Check if filter has magnet; 3. Reinstall and ensure clips click into place. Please provide photos for further diagnosis.
entries.response_cn: 2310 错误：1. 取出尘盒，打开盖子检查滤网是否安装；2. 检查滤网是否有磁铁；3. 重新安装并确保卡扣到位。请提供相关照片，我们帮您进一步判断。

entries.question_en: Base station dirty water pump error
entries.question_cn: 基站污水泵错误/污水未排空
entries.response_en: 6026: 1. If water in tray, check dirty tank latch and tray installation; 2. If no water in tray, gently shake dirty water reservoir to confirm white float moves freely. If not recoverable, we'll replace the dirty water tank.
entries.response_cn: 6026 错误：1. 如托盘有积水，检查污水箱卡扣是否卡紧、托盘是否安装到位；2. 如托盘无积水，轻摇机器人污水箱，确认白色浮球可上下移动。如无法恢复，我们为您更换污水箱。

entries.question_en: Dirty water tank full or not in place
entries.question_cn: 基站污水箱已满或未安装
synonyms_cn: dirty water tank full or not in place
entries.response_en: 6025: Confirm dirty water tank is properly installed and not full. If already emptied and correctly installed but error persists and under warranty, we'll ship a replacement tank.
entries.response_cn: 6025 错误：请确认污水箱已正确安装且未满。如已清空并正确安装仍报错，且在保，我们为您寄送替换污水箱。

entries.question_en: Robot sewage tank not in place
synonyms_cn: sewage tank of the robot is not in place
entries.response_en: 3021: Try applying a small piece of tape to the right side of the robot's back to secure the dirty water reservoir detection sensor. If unwilling to try, and under warranty, we'll provide warranty service.
entries.response_cn: 3021 错误：可尝试在机器人背面右侧贴一小块胶带，固定污水箱检测传感器。如不愿尝试，且在保，我们为您提供保修服务。

entries.question_en: Base station clean water tank not in place
synonyms_en: clean water tank not in place
synonyms_cn: clean water tank not in place
entries.response_en: 6010: Confirm clean water tank is properly installed. If error persists and under warranty, we'll ship a replacement clean water tank.
entries.response_cn: 6010 错误：请确认清水箱已正确安装。如仍报错，且在保，我们为您寄送替换清水箱。

entries.response_en: 3122: Please restart the robot first. If error persists after restart, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 3122 错误：请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.question_en: Clean water tank full but says empty
entries.question_cn: 基站清水箱不足（已加满仍报错）
synonyms_cn: clean water tank empty but full
entries.response_en: 6011: 1. Check seal ring on water outlet; 2. Check magnet at bottom of tank. If error persists, likely base station hardware issue.
entries.response_cn: 6011 错误：1. 取出清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否变形/破损；2. 检查清水箱底部磁铁是否在位。如仍报错，可能是基站硬件问题。

entries.question_en: Dust bin or filter not in place
entries.question_cn: 尘盒或滤网未安装到位
synonyms_cn: dust box or filter not in place
entries.response_en: 2310: 1. Check if filter is installed; 2. Check if filter has magnet; 3. Reinstall and ensure clips click. Provide photos for further diagnosis.
entries.response_cn: 2310 错误：1. 取出尘盒，检查滤网是否安装；2. 检查滤网是否有磁铁；3. 重新安装并确保卡扣到位。请提供照片，我们帮您判断。

entries.question_cn: 洒水器/基站清水泵错误
synonyms_cn: base station clean water pump error
entries.response_en: 6012/6013: Unplug base station power (wait 10s, replug), restart cleaning. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 6012/6013 错误：请先拔插基站电源（拔掉后等 10 秒再插回），重启清洁任务。如仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 5016/5017/5010: Reinstall the battery per video, then restart. If error persists, battery needs replacement.
entries.response_cn: 5016/5017/5010 错误：请按视频重新安装电池，然后重启机器人。如仍报错，需更换电池。

entries.response_en: 1012/1022: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 1012/1022 错误：请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 2010: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 2010 错误：请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 4010: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 4010 错误：请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 4020: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 4020 错误：请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.question_cn: 超声波/地毯检测传感器错误
entries.response_en: 4120/4121: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 4120/4121 错误：请先重启机器人。如重启后仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.question_en: Base station dirty water pump error
synonyms_cn: base station dirty water pump error
entries.response_en: 6022/6023: Unplug base station power (wait 10s, replug), restart. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 6022/6023 错误：请先拔插基站电源（等 10 秒再插回），重启任务。如仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 6040/6041: Unplug base station power (wait 10s, replug), restart. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 6040/6041 错误：请先拔插基站电源（等 10 秒再插回），重启任务。如仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 6110: Check nameplate voltage on back of base station vs. local voltage. If matched, unplug/replug after 10s. If voltage unstable, use a voltage stabilizer.
entries.response_cn: 6110 错误：请核对基站背面铭牌电压是否与当地电压匹配。如匹配，拔插电源 10 秒后重启；如电压不稳，建议配备稳压器。

entries.question_cn: 机器人与基站通信错误
entries.response_en: 5112: 1. Clean infrared lamp lens on station and robot; 2. Ensure no interference from other robot stations; 3. Restart robot, power cycle station.
entries.response_cn: 5112 错误：1. 清洁基站与机器人红外灯透镜；2. 确保基站周围无其他机器人基站干扰；3. 重启机器人，基站断电后重新上电。

entries.question_en: Base station dirty water tank full
entries.response_en: 6021: Empty the dirty water tank. If already empty but error persists, open tank lid and check float for free movement.
entries.response_cn: 6021 错误：请清空污水箱。如已清空仍报错，打开污水箱盖检查浮球是否在位、是否可上下移动。

synonyms_cn: clean water tank or dirty water tank not connected
entries.response_en: 6020: Reinstall the dirty water tank. If error persists, open lid and check float for free movement.
entries.response_cn: 6020 错误：请重新安装污水箱。如仍报错，打开污水箱盖检查浮球是否在位、是否可上下移动。

entries.question_en: Clean water tank not in place
synonyms_en: clean water tank not in place
synonyms_cn: clean water tank not in place
entries.response_en: 6010: Reinstall the clean water tank. If error persists, check magnet at bottom of tank.
entries.response_cn: 6010 错误：请重新安装清水箱。如仍报错，检查清水箱底部磁铁是否在位。

entries.question_en: Dirty water tank full or not in place
synonyms_cn: dirty water tank full or not in place
entries.response_en: 6025: 1. Check tank installation; 2. Remove tank and confirm it's empty; 3. Check float position.
entries.response_cn: 6025 错误：1. 检查污水箱是否安装到位；2. 取出污水箱，确认已清空；3. 检查浮球是否在位。

entries.response_en: 4091: Wipe right wall sensor with soft cloth, place on flat ground and restart.
entries.response_cn: 4091 错误：请用软布擦拭机器人右侧墙体传感器，置于平整地面重启。

entries.question_en: Robot trapped / not touching ground / floating
entries.question_cn: 机器人被困/未接触地面/悬空
entries.response_en: 7000/7001/7002/7003: Move robot to open flat ground. If error persists, enable log upload — our engineers will analyze.
entries.response_cn: 7000/7001/7002/7003 错误：请将机器人移至开阔平整地面启动。如平整地面仍报错，请开启日志上传，工程师帮您分析。

entries.question_cn: 激光传感器被遮挡/卡住
entries.response_en: 4011/4012/4013/4130: 1. Ensure top panel protective film is removed; 2. Remove foreign objects around radar; 3. Clean radar transmitting/receiving holes with cotton swab; 4. Manually rotate radar to confirm free movement.
entries.response_cn: 4011/4012/4013/4130 错误：1. 确保顶部面板保护膜已撕除；2. 移除雷达周围异物；3. 用棉签清洁雷达收发孔；4. 手动转动雷达确认可自由旋转。

entries.response_en: 4111/4112: Tap the front bumper gently to check if it rebounds. If not, try to pull out the stuck part. Under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 4111/4112 错误：请轻拍前撞板，确认可正常回弹。如无法回弹，尝试拉出卡住部位。在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 7033: 1. Confirm base station is powered on (white light steady); 2. Confirm doors on return path are open and no obstacles; 3. If map mismatch, rebuild map.
entries.response_cn: 7033 错误：1. 确认基站通电、白灯常亮；2. 确认机器人回充路径门已打开、无障碍物；3. 如地图与实际不符，建议重建地图。

entries.question_en: Return failed - clear area around station
entries.question_cn: 返回基站失败（基站周围有障碍）
synonyms_cn: return failed clear area around station
entries.response_en: 7031: 1. Clear obstacles around the base station, ensure sufficient space; 2. Do not place station on carpet; 3. Check swivel wheel for severe hair entanglement.
entries.response_cn: 7031 错误：1. 清理基站周围障碍物，确保周围有足够空间；2. 不要将基站放在地毯上；3. 检查机器人万向轮是否严重缠绕头发。

entries.response_en: 7011: 1. Remove obstacles at carpet edges; 2. Check carpet detection sensor for dirt — clean with cotton swab and restart.
entries.response_cn: 7011 错误：1. 移除地毯边缘障碍物；2. 检查地毯检测传感器是否脏污，用棉签清洁后重启任务。

entries.response_en: 7010: Move robot outside the no-go zone. If frequent, enlarge the no-go zone in the app.
entries.response_cn: 7010 错误：请将机器人移出禁区启动。如频繁误入，建议在 App 中扩大禁区范围。

entries.response_en: 7032: 1. If no station on this floor, manually return; 2. If station present, confirm powered on (white light); 3. Start cleaning from the station; 4. If map abnormal, rebuild map.
entries.response_cn: 7032 错误：1. 如本层无基站，手动放回即可；2. 如本层有基站，确认通电且白灯常亮；3. 建议从基站启动清洁任务；4. 如地图异常，建议重建地图。

entries.question_en: Unable to identify position / positioning failure
entries.question_cn: 无法识别位置/重定位失败
entries.response_en: 7020/7021: Environment change caused positioning failure. Please rebuild map and start a new task.
entries.response_cn: 7020/7021 错误：环境变化较大导致定位失败。请重建地图后启动新任务。

entries.response_en: 7052: 1. Check for obstacles, closed doors, incorrect virtual walls/no-go zones, pets blocking; 2. If map mismatch, rebuild map.
entries.response_cn: 7052 错误：1. 检查障碍物、关闭的门、错误虚拟墙/禁区、宠物是否阻挡；2. 如地图与实际不符，建议重建地图。

entries.response_en: 7050: 1. Check for doors, virtual walls/no-go zones, pets blocking; 2. If map mismatch, redraw map.
entries.response_cn: 7050 错误：1. 检查大门、虚拟墙/禁区、宠物是否阻挡；2. 如地图与实际不符，建议重绘地图。

entries.response_en: 7053: Move robot to flat surface before starting. If error persists, restart robot.
entries.response_cn: 7053 错误：请将机器人移至平整地面启动。如平整地面仍报错，请重启机器人。

entries.response_en: 7034: Robot started without base station and cannot return to start point due to obstacles. Please place robot on base station to charge and start a new task.
entries.response_cn: 7034 错误：机器人非从基站出发，清洁完成后需返回起点，但被障碍物/门阻挡。请将机器人放回基站充电，重新启动任务。

entries.response_en: 4041: Wipe camera surface with soft cloth, place robot on flat ground and restart.
entries.response_cn: 4041 错误：请用软布擦拭机器人摄像头表面，置于平整地面重启。

entries.response_en: 4040: Please restart the robot and confirm if the alert is cleared.
entries.response_cn: 4040 错误：请重启机器人，确认提示是否消除。

entries.response_en: 2110/2111/2113: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 2110/2111/2113 错误：请先重启机器人。如仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 2210/2211/2213: Please restart the robot. If error persists, it's a hardware failure — under warranty, we'll replace.
entries.response_cn: 2210/2211/2213 错误：请先重启机器人。如仍报错，属于硬件故障，在保可换新。

entries.response_en: 3123/3133: Flip robot over, remove mop pad holder, clean foreign objects and hair.
entries.response_cn: 3123/3133 错误：请翻面机器人，取下拖布支架，清理异物和头发。

entries.question_en: Dust bag full/not installed/fan cooling/pressure abnormal
entries.question_cn: 尘袋满/未安装/风扇冷却/压力异常
entries.response_en: 6112: Replace dust bag, check duct blockage. 6113: Reinstall dust bag. 6114: Wait 15 min for cooling. 6115: Unplug/replug power after 10s.
entries.response_cn: 6112：更换新尘袋，检查风道堵塞。6113：重新安装尘袋。6114：等待 15 分钟散热后重试。6115：拔插电源 10 秒后重试。

entries.question_en: Cleaning tray not installed / water level abnormal / sewage pump error
entries.question_cn: 清洁托盘未安装/水位异常/污水泵异常
entries.response_en: 6030/6031/6032: 1. Check cleaning tray installation; 2. Check tray float installation; 3. Check dirty water tank seal ring for collapse — manually pull flat.
entries.response_cn: 6030/6031/6032 错误：1. 检查清洁托盘是否安装正确；2. 检查托盘浮标是否安装正确；3. 检查污水箱密封圈是否塌陷，手动拉平。

entries.question_en: Base station water leakage / abnormal sewage pumping
entries.question_cn: 基站可能漏水/污水泵异常
synonyms_cn: base station may have water leakage
entries.response_en: 6028: Check cleaning tray grille for sediment/foreign object blockage, clean the tray.
entries.response_cn: 6028 错误：请检查基站清洁托盘格栅是否被泥沙/异物堵塞，清理托盘。

entries.response_en: 6111: Check if the dust collection station lid is fully closed.
entries.response_cn: 6111 错误：请检查集尘站盖子是否完全关闭。

entries.response_en: 5023/5024: Robot pauses charging to protect battery when temp is below 7°C or too high. Move to suitable temperature environment — charging resumes automatically.
entries.response_cn: 5023/5024 错误：环境温度过低（<7°C）或过高时，机器人会暂停充电以保护电池。请移至适宜温度环境，温度恢复后自动继续充电。

entries.question_cn: 低电量无法启动定时任务
synonyms_cn: low battery failed to start scheduled cleaning
entries.response_en: 5015: Robot battery too low to start scheduled task. Please charge and retry.
entries.response_cn: 5015 错误：机器人电量低，无法启动定时任务。请充电后重试。

entries.question_cn: 返回基站失败（基站未通电）
synonyms_cn: return failed check if station is powered
entries.response_en: 7035: Confirm base station is powered on (white light steady). If power cord is connected but light off, check back socket for tight connection.
entries.response_cn: 7035 错误：请确认基站通电、白灯常亮。如电源线已连接但灯不亮，检查基站背面插座是否插紧。

entries.response_en: 1. Press and hold power button for 12 seconds to reset; 2. Remove pump hub, place suction port on palm, turn on — if suction felt, issue is accessories; if no suction, hub needs repair.
entries.response_cn: 1. 长按电源键 12 秒重置。如无效，取下主机，将吸入口对准手掌，开机测试是否有吸力。如主机有吸力，问题在配件；如无吸力，主机需维修。

entries.response_en: 1. Check duckbill valve for cracks/deformation/reversed installation; 2. Check diaphragm for damage; 3. Check elasticity bowl for compression/rebound. Duckbill valves and elasticity bowls are consumable parts — replace every 3-6 months.
entries.response_cn: 请检查：1. 鸭嘴阀是否有裂纹、变形或安装反了；2. 隔膜是否有破损；3. 弹力碗是否能正常压缩回弹。鸭嘴阀和弹力碗是易耗品，建议每 3-6 个月更换。

entries.response_en: 1. Press and hold power button for 12 seconds to reset; 2. Try placing pump in charging case at a different angle; 3. Confirm magnetic contacts; 4. If still not working and buttons undamaged, provide shipping address for replacement.
entries.response_cn: 请先长按电源键 12 秒重置。如无效，尝试将吸奶器换个角度放入充电盒，确认磁吸触点接触良好。如仍无法开机，且按钮无损坏，请提供收货地址，我们为您换新。

entries.question_cn: 充电盒无法给主机充电
entries.response_en: 1. Clean magnetic contacts on both case and pump hub with dry cloth; 2. Ensure charging case itself has charge (charge case first); 3. Cross-test: place other pump in this case, or this pump in another case, to identify issue.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 将充电盒内磁吸触点和主机充电触点用干布清洁；2. 确认充电盒自身有电（先给充电盒充电）；3. 交叉测试：将另一只主机放入此充电盒，或将此主机放入另一充电盒，判断是盒问题还是主机问题。

entries.question_en: Won't fully charge - stuck at low battery
entries.question_cn: 充不满电，一直停留在低电量
entries.response_en: 1. Confirm magnetic contacts (listen for click, indicator flashes white); 2. Confirm charging duration: pump 1.7 hours, case 3.2 hours; 3. Try different charger/cable; 4. Press and hold power button for 12 seconds to reset.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认磁吸触点接触良好（听到“咔哒”声、指示灯闪白）；2. 确认充电时长：主机充满约 1.7 小时，充电盒充满约 3.2 小时；3. 尝试更换充电线/充电头；4. 长按电源键 12 秒重置。

entries.response_en: 1. Press heating pin firmly into container oval slot, then install hub and press to seal; 2. Clean metal contacts with dry cloth; 3. Confirm operating temperature -20°C to 42°C; 4. Press and hold power button for 12 seconds to reset.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 将加热针用力按入容器椭圆槽，再安装主机并按压密封；2. 用干布清洁加热盖与主机连接的金属触点；3. 确认工作温度在 -20°C 至 42°C 之间；4. 长按电源键 12 秒重置。

entries.question_en: Left and right motors perform differently
synonyms_cn: left and right motors perform differently
entries.response_en: 1. Confirm both sides have silicone breast shields, duckbill valves, elasticity bowls correctly installed; 2. Remove pump hub, test suction on palm for each side; 3. Press and hold power button for 12 seconds to reset; 4. Press and hold power + “+” buttons for 5 seconds for factory reset.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认两侧硅胶护罩、鸭嘴阀、弹力碗安装正确、无损坏或装反；2. 分别取下主机，对准手掌测试两侧吸力；3. 长按电源键 12 秒重置；4. 同时长按电源键和+键 5 秒恢复出厂设置。

entries.response_en: 1. Confirm battery sufficient — low battery may cause auto-shutdown; 2. Press and hold power button for 12 seconds to reset; 3. Press and hold power + “+” buttons for 5 seconds for factory reset; 4. Check buttons for sticking/water ingress; ensure room temperature >10°C.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认电量充足，低电量可能导致自动关机；2. 长按电源键 12 秒重置；3. 同时长按电源键和+键 5 秒恢复出厂设置；4. 检查按钮是否卡住、是否进水，确保在室温（>10°C）下使用。

entries.response_en: 1. Stop using immediately, cool in well-ventilated area; 2. Ensure room temperature >10°C, avoid high-temp environments; 3. Ensure ventilation vents unobstructed; 4. If overheating persists, stop use and contact support.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 立即停止使用，置于阴凉通风处冷却；2. 确保在室温（>10°C）下使用，避免高温环境；3. 确保通风口未被堵塞；4. 如持续过热，请停止使用并联系技术支持。

entries.response_en: Melting is most likely caused by incorrect sterilization methods. Please confirm: 1. Charging case is NOT washable — wipe with damp cloth only; 2. Only washable parts can be steam sterilized (5 minutes recommended); 3. Do NOT microwave sterilize.
entries.response_cn: 熔化最可能由错误的消毒方式引起。请确认：1. 充电盒不可水洗，只能用湿布擦拭；2. 仅可水洗部件可蒸汽消毒（建议 5 分钟）；3. 禁止微波消毒。

entries.response_en: 1. New pump may have slight odor from silicone vulcanization — normal and safe. Boil 5 minutes or air out a few hours to eliminate; 2. If abnormal burning smell, stop use immediately and confirm no incorrect sterilization (e.g., microwave) was used.
entries.response_cn: 1. 新品可能有轻微气味（硅胶硫化过程），属正常，煮沸 5 分钟或通风数小时即可消除；2. 如为异常烧焦味，请立即停止使用，并确认是否使用了错误消毒方式（如微波）。

entries.response_en: 1. Place pump on flat sturdy surface to avoid resonance; 2. Fully disassemble and reassemble all accessories; 3. Check silicone valve and sealing ring for damage/dirt; 4. Compare noise at low vs. high settings; 5. If persists, record 10+ second video/audio and share with support.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 将吸奶器放在平稳坚固表面，避免共振；2. 完全拆装所有配件；3. 检查硅胶阀和密封圈是否损坏或脏污；4. 对比低档和高档噪音变化；5. 如仍异常，请录制 10 秒以上视频/音频，我们转交技术团队分析。

entries.response_en: 1. Check duckbill valve and diaphragm for damage; 2. Use nipple measurement card to confirm flange size; 3. Ensure nipple is centered in flange tunnel; 4. Start with letdown mode, then switch to expression mode; 5. Pump in a relaxed environment.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 检查鸭嘴阀和隔膜是否损坏；2. 用乳头测量卡确认喇叭罩尺寸；3. 确保乳头居中于喇叭罩通道；4. 先使用催乳模式刺激奶阵，再切换到吸乳模式；5. 在放松环境下吸奶。

entries.response_en: 1. Start from lowest setting, gradually increase to comfort level; 2. Confirm correct flange size; 3. Ensure nipple centered in flange tunnel; 4. Try Gentle Flow mode in app; 5. If pain persists, consult a lactation consultant.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 从最低档开始，逐步调至舒适档位；2. 确认喇叭罩尺寸合适；3. 确保乳头居中于喇叭罩通道；4. 如仍疼痛，可尝试 App 中的 Gentle Flow 模式；5. 如持续疼痛，建议咨询哺乳顾问。

entries.response_en: 1. Identify leak location (flange opening or bottle connection); 2. If from flange opening, check duckbill valve installation and cracks; 3. If from bottle connection, check flange and connector assembly; 4. Use full-coverage nursing bra; 5. Do not lean back during pumping.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认漏奶位置（喇叭罩口 or 瓶身连接处）；2. 如从喇叭罩口漏，检查鸭嘴阀是否安装正确、是否有裂纹；3. 如从瓶身连接处漏，检查喇叭罩与连接器是否安装紧密；4. 使用全罩杯哺乳文胸确保密封；5. 吸奶时不要后仰。

entries.response_en: 1. First use: Boil all washable parts for no more than 5 minutes (stir continuously) or steam sterilize; 2. Daily use: Rinse with warm soapy water, air dry; 3. Dishwasher: washable parts on top rack; 4. Do NOT microwave sterilize.
entries.response_cn: 1. 首次使用：所有可水洗部件煮沸不超过 5 分钟（持续搅动防粘底），或蒸汽消毒；2. 日常使用：温水+肥皂水冲洗，风干；3. 洗碗机：可水洗部件放顶层；4. 禁止微波消毒。

entries.response_en: Charging case is NOT washable. Wipe inside and outside with damp cloth (including magnetic charging port), air dry completely before placing pump back. Do NOT submerge in water or put in dishwasher.
entries.response_cn: 充电盒不可水洗。请用湿布擦拭内外表面（包括磁吸充电口），风干后再放入主机。禁止浸泡水中或放入洗碗机。

entries.response_en: 1. Pump hub: 1-year warranty; 2. Washable parts (duckbill valves, diaphragms, flanges, etc.): 3-month warranty.
entries.response_cn: 1. 主机：1 年保修；2. 可水洗部件（鸭嘴阀、隔膜、喇叭罩等）：3 个月保修。

entries.response_en: As a medical and personal hygiene device, returns are accepted only if: 1. Item is new, unopened with intact seals, unused; 2. Original packaging; 3. Requested within 30 days of purchase. If you've started pumping and experience issues, please contact us for assistance.
entries.response_cn: 作为医疗和个人卫生设备，退货需满足：1. 商品为全新未开封状态、密封完整、未使用；2. 原包装完好；3. 购买后 30 天内申请。如已开始使用并遇到问题，我们鼓励您联系我们获取帮助。

entries.response_en: 1. Check battery level — charge if low; 2. Press SYNC button to confirm power on (LED off → hold 2 seconds to power on); 3. If recently relocated, move closer to router; 4. Check signal strength; 5. Remove and re-add camera in app; 6. HomeBase Settings > General > Working Mode > Performance (Beta); 7. Enable HomeBase Wi-Fi repeater; 8. If still offline, provide SN and logs.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 检查电池电量，过低请充电；2. 按 SYNC 键确认是否开机（LED 不亮则长按 2 秒开机）；3. 如最近移动过位置，请移近路由器；4. 检查信号强度；5. 从 App 删除并重新添加摄像头；6. HomeBase 设置 > 通用 > 工作模式 > Performance (Beta)；7. 开启 HomeBase Wi-Fi 中继功能；8. 如仍离线，提供设备 SN 和日志。

entries.response_en: 1. Confirm router is 2.4GHz (5GHz not supported); 2. Confirm Wi-Fi password correct; 3. Confirm SSID not hidden, security protocol WPA/WPA2; 4. Ensure camera battery sufficient; 5. Keep camera and HomeBase within 3m during pairing.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认路由器为 2.4GHz（不支持 5GHz）；2. 确认 Wi-Fi 密码正确；3. 确认 SSID 未隐藏，安全协议为 WPA/WPA2；4. 确保摄像头电量充足；5. 配对时保持摄像头与 HomeBase 3 米内。

entries.response_en: 1. Remove camera lens protective film; 2. Hold SYNC button for at least 2 seconds until beep (no beep → charge first); 3. Keep camera and HomeBase within 3m during pairing; 4. Ensure QR code clear, phone brightness high, scan distance ~40cm; 5. Confirm Wi-Fi is 2.4GHz.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 移除摄像头镜头保护膜；2. 长按 SYNC 键至少 2 秒，听到“滴”声（无滴声则先充电）；3. 配对时保持摄像头与 HomeBase 3 米内；4. 确保 QR 码清晰、手机亮度高、扫描距离约 40cm；5. 确认 Wi-Fi 为 2.4GHz。

entries.response_en: 1. Clean camera lens with soft cloth; 2. Avoid installing camera near walls or light sources (IR reflection causes overexposure); 3. Adjust angle to keep obstacles out of view.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 用软布清洁镜头；2. 避免将摄像头安装在墙壁或灯源附近（红外反射导致过曝）；3. 调整角度，确保障碍物不在视野内。

entries.response_en: 1. Clean lens gently with soft dry cloth; 2. Check for water condensation on lens — wipe and confirm if image clears; 3. Ensure camera is not installed near walls or reflective surfaces.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 用软干布轻轻清洁镜头；2. 检查镜头是否有水汽凝结，擦拭后确认图像是否清晰；3. 确保摄像头未安装在墙壁或反光表面附近。

entries.response_en: 1. Increase motion detection sensitivity; 2. Side-mount camera (PIR lateral detection is better); 3. Confirm motion detection enabled and correct security mode; 4. Confirm battery sufficient (low battery reduces sensitivity); 5. Update camera firmware.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 提高运动检测灵敏度；2. 将摄像头侧装（PIR 横向检测更优）；3. 确认运动检测已开启且当前处于正确的安全模式；4. 确认电量充足（低电量会降低传感器灵敏度）；5. 升级摄像头固件至最新版。

entries.response_en: 1. Lower detection sensitivity; 2. Set Activity Zone to exclude roads, sidewalks, high-traffic areas; 3. Adjust camera angle — avoid pointing at heat sources, moving trees, or roads; 4. Ensure camera not pointed at strong lights or reflective surfaces.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 降低检测灵敏度；2. 设置活动区域，排除马路、人行道等高频触发区域；3. 调整摄像头角度，避免朝向热源、移动树木或道路；4. 确保摄像头不直射强光源或反光表面。

entries.response_en: 1. Confirm solar panel cable firmly connected and not damaged; 2. Confirm solar panel unobstructed, receives several hours of direct sunlight daily; 3. Confirm charging temperature 0-45°C; 4. Check Power Source setting in app.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认太阳能板与摄像头连接牢固、未损坏；2. 确认太阳能板无遮挡，每天接受数小时直射阳光；3. 确认充电温度在 0-45°C 之间；4. 在 App 中确认 Power Source 设置正确。

entries.question_en: Solar charging slow / battery draining quickly
entries.question_cn: 太阳能充电慢/电量下降快
entries.response_en: 1. Confirm solar panel direct sunlight, unobstructed; 2. Temporarily disable motion detection to check if battery rises — identify if frequent triggers cause drain; 3. Select Optimal Battery Life mode, lower sensitivity, enable Human Only, configure Activity Zone; 4. Clean solar panel surface; 5. Check if solar charging icon appears in app.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确认太阳能板接受直射阳光、无遮挡；2. 暂时关闭运动检测，观察电量是否上升，判断是否因频繁触发导致耗电过快；3. 选择 Optimal Battery Life 模式，降低灵敏度，开启 Human Only 模式，配置活动区域；4. 清洁太阳能板表面；5. 检查 App 中是否显示太阳能充电图标。

entries.response_en: 1. Select Power Save working mode; 2. Select Human Only detection mode; 3. Lower motion detection sensitivity; 4. Enable Activity Zone to reduce invalid recordings; 5. Ensure solar panel receives maximum direct sunlight.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 选择 Power Save 工作模式；2. 选择 Human Only 检测模式；3. 降低运动检测灵敏度；4. 启用活动区域，减少无效录制；5. 确保太阳能板接受最大直射阳光。

entries.question_en: AI false detection (pet detected as human)
entries.question_cn: AI 误识别（宠物识别为人）
entries.response_en: 1. AI detection algorithm continuously optimized — send original video for AI training; 2. If only human detection needed, set Detection Type = Human Only; 3. Update camera and HomeBase firmware to latest.
entries.response_cn: 1. AI 检测算法持续优化中，请将原始视频发送给我们，用于 AI 训练；2. 如仅需检测人，请设置 Detection Type = Human Only；3. 升级摄像头和 HomeBase 固件至最新版。

entries.response_en: 1. Effective face recognition range: within 6m front-facing; 2. Add multi-angle, clear face photos, update when appearance changes; 3. Face recognition not supported in B&W infrared night vision mode; 4. Update HomeBase firmware.
entries.response_cn: 1. 有效人脸识别范围：正面 6 米内；2. 添加多角度、清晰的人脸照片，并在外貌变化时更新；3. 夜间红外模式下不支持人脸识别；4. 升级 HomeBase 固件至最新版。

entries.response_en: 1. Ensure stable network; 2. Check camera LED status: Red-blue alternating = updating, wait ~5 min; LED off = press SYNC, blue flash = powered on, red flash = low battery, charge and retry.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确保网络稳定；2. 检查摄像头 LED 状态：红蓝交替闪烁 = 正在升级，等待约 5 分钟；LED 熄灭 = 按 SYNC 键，蓝闪 = 已开机，红闪 = 电量低，请充电后重试。

entries.response_en: 1. Ensure phone has stable Wi-Fi or cellular connection; 2. If camera signal weak, move closer to router; 3. Check camera-to-HomeBase signal strength.
entries.response_cn: 请1. 确保手机有稳定的 Wi-Fi 或蜂窝连接；2. 如摄像头信号弱，请移近路由器；3. 检查摄像头与 HomeBase 之间的信号强度。

entries.response_en: Recording stops based on: 1. Maximum recording duration (Battery Life: 20s / Surveillance: 60s); 2. AI detects no human/vehicle/pet for sustained period. For longer recordings, switch to Optimal Surveillance mode or Customize Recording mode.
entries.response_cn: 录制停止取决于以下条件之一：1. 达到最大录制时长（Battery Life 模式 20 秒 /
